payload.statement: The claim is supported because the current v2 returns policy explicitly states a 30-day full-refund window for standard items, while the 14-day value appears only in stale v1/judge reference data.
payload.plan: Extracted numeric return windows from policy_docs, base_retrieval, and base_judge_reference_days; compared the claimed 30 days to the current-labeled policy; computed order eligibility under current and stale windows and the day discrepancy; a two-sample t-test was not applicable because no n/mean/sd fields were provided.

evidence.statistical_test: not applicable: no n/mean/sd fields; deterministic policy consistency check used
